OCR · Beta

OCR: read text from images and scans

Read text from images and scanned PDFs on your device. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

OCR has these main features: Every page of a PDF, read at 200 dpi; Boxes on the page, and the text editable before you save. It opens Any image, PDF.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with OCR

  • Copy the text from a picture
  • Turn a scanned PDF into a searchable PDF
